name: @arena/developer-platform
description: Arena developer platform domain core (Work Order C017; issue #123). Scoped API keys for client applications (hashed-at-rest secrets, rotation/revocation as append-only transitions, never role authority), client-app and webhook registration over the C001 delivery seam, visibly-labelled deterministic sandbox escalations (demo money is not customer money) and per-client-app escalation observability projections (lifecycle, validation, SLA timestamps, cost/fee) built from C001 events and C010 records.
